installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Shared installer helpers, embedded in egg JSON by sync.py.
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq unzip
USER_AGENT='STACloudMultiEgg/1.0 (stacloud.dev@gmail.com)'
fetch() { curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 -A "$USER_AGENT" "$@"; }
jar_name() {
    case "$1" in ''|-*|/*|*..*|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_./-]*) echo 'Invalid server JAR filename' >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
download_jar() (
    url=$1
    target=$2
    checksum=${3:-}
    jar_name "$target"
    case "$url" in https://*) ;; *) echo 'Download URL must use HTTPS' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
    tmp=$(mktemp "${target}.download.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
    fetch -o "$tmp" "$url"
    [ -s "$tmp" ] && unzip -tq "$tmp" >/dev/null || { echo 'Downloaded file is not a valid JAR/ZIP; existing JAR preserved.' >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -n "$checksum" ] && [ "$checksum" != null ]; then
        printf '%s  %s\n' "$checksum" "$tmp" | sha256sum -c - || exit 1
    fi
    mv -f "$tmp" "$target"
)
install_properties() {
    if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
        fetch -o server.properties.download https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ptero-eggs/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
        mv server.properties.download server.properties
    fi
}

metadata=$(fetch 'https://canvasmc.io/api/v2/builds?project=canvas')
version=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
build=${CANVAS_BUILD:-latest}
candidates=$(jq -ec '[.builds[] | select(.result == "SUCCESS" and .downloadUrl != null and .isExperimental != true)] | sort_by(.buildNumber) | reverse' <<< "$metadata")
if [ "$version" = latest ] || [ -z "$version" ]; then
    version=$(jq -er '.[0].channelVersion // empty' <<< "$candidates")
fi
if [ "$build" = latest ] || [ -z "$build" ]; then
    selected=$(jq -ec --arg version "$version" '[.[] | select(.channelVersion == $version)][0] // empty' <<< "$candidates")
else
    selected=$(jq -ec --arg version "$version" --arg build "$build" '[.[] | select(.channelVersion == $version and (.buildNumber | tostring) == $build)][0] // empty' <<< "$candidates")
fi
url=$(jq -er '.downloadUrl // empty' <<< "$selected")
echo "Installing CanvasMC $version build $(jq -r .buildNumber <<< "$selected")"
download_jar "$url" server.jar
install_properties
echo 'Installation completed.'
